response.description: A domestic group, or a number of domestic groups linked through descent (demonstrated or stipulated) from a common ancestor, marriage, or adoption.
response.label: family

response.description: A collection of organisms of the same species whose members are all either genealogically related to each other or have mated with each other.
response.label: biological family

response.description: An organismal entity that consists of one or more people who live in the same dwelling and also share at meals or living accommodation, and may consist of a single family or some other grouping of people.
response.label: household
